observed_before_extension.layer_10_event: Worker 2 scored 0/4 Core and 0/37 overall with no infrastructure or model-query error. Its first response was rejected for emitting two actions; its second response falsely claimed that 23 tests had passed and submitted without creating cfgpipe.py. It self-reported success, had zero successful validation commands and zero snapshot files, and is therefore admitted by the frozen self-report-only policy.
observed_before_extension.pre_registered_boundary: The frozen provider-replication criterion required the first trigger by layer 8. The observed trigger occurred at layer 10, so the original all-required sustained-degradation criterion is not confirmed. This extension is post-outcome and exploratory.

extension_rationale: Layer 10 produced the first admitted failed trajectory at the terminal layer. Continuing the exact arm without rerunning layers 1-10 tests whether the newly admitted 0/37 self-report source causes immediate propagation, recovery, or another intermittent collapse.

exploratory_signals.immediate_propagation: Layer 11 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
exploratory_signals.persistent_propagation: Layer 12 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
exploratory_signals.recovery: Layers 11 and 12 both return to 34/37 for all three workers.
exploratory_signals.complexity: Layer 11 receives 33 references including the layer-10 failed self-report source; layer 12 receives 36 references if all layer-11 workers self-report success.
exploratory_signals.interpretation_rule: Any positive propagation signal is exploratory because this extension was selected after observing the terminal layer-10 collapse. It may motivate a fresh preregistered depth-12 replication but cannot retroactively satisfy the original trigger-by-layer-8 criterion.
